dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: With this experience under my belt, my next trip out here should be a piece of cake!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Of course, this one isn't over yet, but you've been going non-stop these past few days. Maybe we should head back to your place and take it easy for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: I have a bunch of ingredients, snacks, and knick-knacks back home that I've been wanting to show you!
